title: Gözleme manifest envelope v1 (GOZ-0006)
description: Validated by Gözleme's own envelope reader (contracts/manifest-validation.md stages 1–3). Family/format/encoding pairs are constrained by native-formats.md. Unknown members are unknown_field; reserved names are reserved_claim. The $id is an identifier only and is never fetched.

capability.description: Canonical capability ID gz://<origin>/cap/<uuid> or alias <handle>/<name>; must identify the target exactly (identity_mismatch otherwise).

version.description: Declared capability version, Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 syntax only (ordering and uniqueness: GOZ-0007).

document.description: The native document as a string; its UTF-8 bytes are the native bytes (≤ 512 KiB).
